mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both show YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply chain boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with both proxies growing > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery, a RSAFS increase > $50B signals strengthening consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC in post-shock recoveries remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) and low CPIAUCSL (< 300) together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to monetary tightening with low inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns in high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200k signals strong labor market growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth > 3% and UNRATE < 4%, it signals a balanced supply and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC in balanced supply and labor market conditions remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
